title: RuleExplanation
description: Output of `rulekit explain` — a rule's condition projected for understanding. `operators` is the glossary (each distinct construct once, with meaning/gotchas); `tree` is the structure, and every tree node's `operator` is a BACKLINK into `operators[].id` (meanings are not repeated per node).

text.description: the canonical EN rendering of the whole condition

operators.description: glossary of the distinct operators used, in encounter order; tree nodes reference these by id

id.description: catalog operator-id; the key tree nodes backlink to via `op`

kind.description: OPERATOR | PREDICATE | FUNCTION | CONSTANT ("?" if the id is unknown to the catalog)

gotchas.description: author-relevant surprises the kernel is silent on

kind.description: the model value-kind, or "GROUP" for a group reference

iterates.description: whether the condition ranges over a repeatable group

iterationGroup.description: the repeatable group iterated over; present only when `iterates` is true

node.description: one node of the condition's structure. `operator` backlinks into operators[].id; `text` is the rendered DSL of this subtree. `children` are the operator-bearing operands (a LogicCondition's two sides, a comparison's function/aggregate operands), in source order; value operands (fields, literals) are shown in `text`, not as nodes.

operator.description: operator-id — a key into the `operators` glossary

text.description: the rendered DSL of this subtree
